problems: imamate-of-oman: vassal_start/vassal_end name sultanate-of-oman as counterpart, as the review asked, but the schema defines the counterpart of a vassal event as the vassal itself; sultanate-of-oman /ledger/19 and /ledger/21 (counterpart imamate-of-oman) are the correct-direction events, so the renderer should draw the vassal tint from the suzerain's dossier only. The same applies to asir's vassal_start/vassal_end with counterpart kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd.

asir: the Hodeidah page (Yemen captured the city in April 1925) moved the loss of Hodeidah from 1924 to April 1925; north-yemen (verdict fix, not touched) still has its mirror gain in 1924 (/ledger/3, confidence 1) and should read April 1925 citing https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hodeidah.

imamate-of-oman: the 15 December 1955 loss of Nizwa and the 1957 regain of the Nizwa district have no mirror in sultanate-of-oman (me-10-c), which covers 1954-1959 as one contest and gains the interior in 1959; its 1920 vassal, 1954 vassal_end/contest_start and 1959 contest_end/gain are now matched.

asir: the 1919 gain of the Abha highlands is matched by ottoman-empire /ledger/230 (loss of Asir to asir, 1919); asir's 1909, 1911 and 1915 Ottoman-counterpart events still have no mirror in ottoman-empire.

Page budgets exceeded because the repairs needed the pages: imamate-of-oman used 3 pages (budget 1-2: Imamate of Oman, Treaty of Seeb, Jebel Akhdar War); asir used 4 own pages (budget 1-2: Asir Province, Idrisid Emirate of Asir, Hodeidah, Saudi-Yemeni war (1934)) plus the Mutawakkilite page opened earlier for north-yemen.

Thin items: asir Hodeidah date applied (Hodeidah page); the Idrisid remnant extent (Hasan al-Idrisi page failed) stays unknown; imamate rulers added from the Treaty of Seeb and Jebel Akhdar War pages because the Salim ibn Rashid al-Kharusi page failed.
